description: Na₂YCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.70 Å. Y is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.38 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.33 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₂YC trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂YP tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONa₂YC trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₂YC trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂YP tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONa₂YC trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂YP tetrahedra.
